text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

An all-male panel chose a male candidate over you, also male. Sex cannot plausibly explain why he was preferred. Raising it would signal you don't understand your own case and would undermine your credibility on the point that actually matters.

The panel composition is a sign of something — weak diversity practice at the broadcaster — but that's an institutional issue, not evidence about your outcome.

Your real grievance is substantive: eight years versus fifteen, and "strong experience of digital media" as the apparent deciding factor. Press that. Ask whether digital experience was in the published criteria and how it was weighted.

Also chase the written explanation; two weeks' silence is worth escalating in writing to HR.
